category: Four empowerments / technical compounds / sign-transmission syntax
problem: The source gives four combinations, four recipient aspects and four degrees of elaboration. It begins the detailed rite with approach/accomplishment/close approach in that order, then eight stages and an awareness-expressiveness empowerment. The sign-based and direct-perception clauses are compressed. rang rig lacks an active whole-expression entry.
treatment: Preserve all fours, the eight-stage count and source order without adding conventional empowerment contents. Use awareness's expressiveness component-preservingly and self-awareness provisionally. Keep the canonical secret preliminary within the explicit samsara/nirvana distinction construction. Retain the bodily and gaze instructions without inventing positions or diagrams. Apply the U02259–U02260 alignment corrections.
uncertainty: The fourfold correspondences, the scope of elaboration, the clear-self-awareness construction and the final authoritative-transmission/sign predicate require review.
action: Approve the whole-expression proposals and examine the full rite against the print. This draft does not itself confer empowerment or supply authorization to perform an omitted ritual.

problem: The pledge account distinguishes embodiment/speech/awakened mind from the yogin's body/speech/mental faculty. It is followed by a discussion of words and nine stages without an explicit fifty-seventh-reply heading; the next printed heading is fifty-eighth. mos pa spyod pa'i sa is a whole technical expression absent from the glossary.
treatment: Preserve the two triads, guru and vajra-sibling objects, and the difference between pledges and vows. Do not invent the missing numbered heading. Provisionally render the full stage expression as ground of aspirational activity, with lower-case ground representing sa rather than gzhi. The source's prediction about future adherents is translated, not independently asserted.
uncertainty: The exact transition between replies fifty-six and fifty-seven, the referent of the final teaching period and the stage designation remain open.
action: Review the transition with the corresponding questions and retain the heading gap explicitly in the structural record.

category: Beyond words / affirmative elaboration phrase / self-awareness
problem: U02319 says spros pa yongs rdzogs che without an explicit negation, despite the beyond-words context. rang shes at U02322 and rang rig at U02324 are distinct. The gathering-all-buddhas clause precedes the nature-of-phenomena subject.
treatment: Retain the affirmative greatly-complete elaboration wording with a query rather than insert freedom from elaboration. Distinguish one's own knowing from the proposed self-awareness compound. Preserve evenness without mixing and apply the U02323–U02324 alignment corrections.
uncertainty: The intended force of the opening affirmative and the exact attachment of gathering all buddhas require review.
action: Collate the opening phrase and review the whole sentence without doctrinal normalization.

category: Direct perception / scan variant / four named visions / threefold measures
problem: The print separates rlab kyang from main bslab in U02332. The four named vision phrases have shortened or reordered forms relative to the glossary. yid dpyod lacks an entry. Three nonmovements, three ways of remaining and three attainments are not individually listed. The relationship of Ground to nonmovement is condensed.
treatment: Preserve the main training reading and separate waves alternative. Use the four established whole-expression vision renderings, recording their recognizable local variants rather than changing every snang ba to vision. Provisionally use mental examination. Keep all threefold measures distinct, bracket supplied referents and apply U02330–U02331 alignment corrections.
uncertainty: The passing-beyond speech instruction, door/three-embodiment construction and precise membership of the threefold sets require review.
action: Approve the local vision-form concordance and examine the complete threefold measures without supplying a standard list from memory.

category: Secret preliminary / bodily verb / mindfulness and reflection / negative scope
problem: The compound explicitly distinguishes samsara and nirvana while naming ru shan. bcud cing in the bodily sequence is uncertain and may be a verb whose spelling requires review. The later-flow-cutting clause and whatever-is-spoken-has-no-reversal clause are compressed. dran pa and dran bsam occur in the mental sequence.
treatment: Keep secret preliminary visible and express the stated act of distinguishing. Render compressing provisionally without inventing a bodily mechanism. Preserve both common/supreme purposes, all voice classes, and every negation. Retain mindfulness as the active glossary component, with mindful as a recorded grammatical form, and keep reflection distinct. Apply U02370–U02371 alignment corrections.
uncertainty: The bcud reading, flow referent, speech nonreversal and mental-sequence syntax remain unresolved. This is not a complete operational practice manual.
action: Review the verb and connected clauses against the print and authorize any contextual mindfulness rendering only through an explicit proposal.

category: Three twenty-onefold accounts / ornaments / signs of death / safety
problem: Twenty-one wind-retaining activities, twenty-one ordinary-mind trainings and twenty-one death signs are announced but not enumerated here. Ornaments, the place and the wheel of dependent connections lack specifications. The three results of ordinary-mind training are explicit. Death-sign examination is a religious practice, not a stated clinical test.
treatment: Preserve all counts, the ornament terminology and the three stated stages. Do not add breath durations, positions, a wheel diagram, missing death signs or diagnostic claims. Keep torma as the named ritual offering and retain the favorable/unfavorable conditions. Apply U02405–U02406 alignment corrections.
uncertainty: The ornaments' identity, the placement of the wheel and the measures governing the practices remain unresolved. No safe breath practice or medical assessment is established.
action: Resolve the referents philologically; do not use the draft to attempt hazardous breath restriction or to predict an individual's death.

category: View/direct perception / Ground and result / unenumerated counts
problem: The source juxtaposes establishing certainty through words with words' inability to reveal the nature of phenomena. It denies dependence on Ground/result and says unarisen unmade phenomena have neither Ground nor root. Four ways of liberation, four crucial points, two/five/eight, four great confidences and three pointings out are not fully enumerated.
treatment: Preserve all contrasts and negations without rewriting them into an external doctrinal explanation. Keep heart-sphere, self-awareness and mental examination visibly provisional, and retain the canonical discerning-knowing eye, four confidences and pointing out components. Do not add members to the numerical sets.
uncertainty: The eye-faculty construction, the exact scope of favorable/unfavorable activities, the heart-sphere phrase and the two/five/eight relation require review.
action: Read the entire view passage with its question and subsequent cultivation account; resolve counts and referents from explicit source evidence.

category: Life-tree metaphor / transmission reading / subtle distinction
problem: The source reads sems kyi lung, not rlung, in the opening. It explicitly says sems nyid with chos at U02477, not chos nyid. The equal-precipices clause and pressing the crucial points are condensed.
treatment: Keep authoritative transmission distinct from wind, preserve nature of ordinary mind in both occurrences, and translate phenomena rather than silently supplying nature of phenomena at U02477. Retain life-tree as a provisional metaphor and all three practice divisions. Do not supply bodily or breathing details beyond the text.
uncertainty: The transmission relationship, the metaphor's exact scope and the equal-precipices construction remain open.
action: Check the two especially confusable source forms and review the full preliminary/main/subsequent sequence; do not treat this draft as safe physiological instruction.

category: Fixings / heading within phrase / exhaustion statements
problem: The three fixings are not enumerated. At U02489 the sixty-seventh-reply heading interrupts the genitive phrase concerning the great yogin's activity; the next unit supplies result. The text says the guru's pith instructions subside and the flow of embodiments and primordial knowing is cut.
treatment: Preserve the threefold count and heading at its source position, carrying the fragment into the following result statement. Keep all exhaustion and nonabiding claims, including the potentially difficult embodiment/primordial-knowing statement, without softening or converting them into a metaphysical assertion of annihilation.
uncertainty: The fixings' identity, the best English linkage across the heading and the intended scope of the final exhaustion statements require review.
action: Review the passage as a whole with the continuation and retain the source's strong wording while separating any later interpretive commentary.
